items.heading: Dholl Puri
details: Key ingredients: split pea flour, flour dough, curry, pickle
Cook and grind split peas into a fine, seasoned powder.
Fill soft dough rounds with the split pea mixture.
Roll out and cook the filled flatbreads on a hot griddle.
Serve folded with curry and tangy pickled vegetables inside.

items.heading: Mauritian Fish Vindaye
details: Key ingredients: fish, mustard seeds, turmeric, vinegar, garlic
Fry fish pieces until golden and set aside.
Blend mustard seeds, turmeric and garlic into a paste.
Cook the paste with vinegar into a tangy sauce.
Coat the fried fish in the sauce and let it marinate before serving.

items.heading: Rougaille
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.

items.heading: Biryani
details: Ingredients: rice, oil/ghee, onion, whole spices, ginger-garlic, vegetables or meat, salt and stock/water.
Rinse and partly cook the rice.
Brown onion and spices, cook the vegetables/meat with seasoning, layer with rice and steam covered on low heat until tender.
